final_sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOCType = 'High Schools (Public)' 
    AND f.`County Name` = 'Monterey' 
    AND f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)] > 800;
